# Insta360 X4 Control Dashboard

**A local control + live-view panel for a 360 camera.**

A dashboard that connects to an Insta360 X4 for live view and control from the desktop. Small, practical hardware-integration work — bridging a device API into a clean web UI.

## Highlights
- Live camera preview in the browser
- Remote capture controls
- Device API → web UI bridge

## Stack
Node.js, Camera API

## Live project
See the write-up, screenshots, and demo at https://sport.taila73942.ts.net/portfolio/project/insta360-x4.html
